findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 logic and query placeholders in platform runtime

evidence.observation: TODO comment indicates unqueried anomalies table: 'recent_anomalies = []  # TODO: Query quality_anomalies table'
Multiple TODO comments indicate missing Phase 5 authorization checking and integration: '# TODO: Phase 5 - implement authorization checking via Supabase'

proposed_action.description: Implement the missing Phase 5 Supabase authorization, decision integration, and quality anomalies query logic or document them under an explicit tracking ticket.

findings.expected_benefit: Completes quality anomaly detection and enforces planned authorization and decision integration in the research pipeline.

findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router status reports configured log file at /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl, but call_log_exists is false and call_log_size_mb is null.

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router process initializes and flushes requests to call_log.jsonl, verifying file path permissions and existence.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility, auditability, and metrics collection for routing policy invocations and model latencies.

findings.title: Fallback to empty string for missing API keys in emergency alert processing

evidence.observation: Calls to GEMINI_API_KEY and MISTRAL_API_KEY default to empty string fallback rather than failing fast or enforcing credential checks: api_key=os.environ.get('GEMINI_API_KEY', '')

proposed_action.description: Enforce explicit credential validation or raise a ConfigurationError when API keys are absent instead of passing empty strings to external provider clients.

findings.expected_benefit: Avoids silent authentication errors and obscure downstream failures by validating credentials early.
